score_notes.A: Markup is clean: no body H1, no skipped levels, all math in $$ with blank lines around display blocks, real tables, fenced code, front matter has subtitle/paper_author/paper_doi/use_math/two-level categories, no author key, description 136 chars starting with 'DPO'. Deductions: L35-59 is an intro/abstract recap after the TL;DR ('### DPO의 주장', L55 '저자들이 주장하는 기여는 다음과 같습니다'); the paper-conclusion recap 'L581 ### 정리: 정책과 보상 사이의 대응' sits as an H3 inside the OOD/GPT-4 section instead of the closing.
score_notes.B: Mostly natural 입니다 register, terms consistent. Deductions: L53 '선호 데이터에 맞춘 암묵적 보상에 대한 최적 정책을' (calque; rewrite '선호 데이터에 맞춘 암묵적 보상의 최적 정책을'); L55 '저자들이 주장하는 기여는 다음과 같습니다.' (formulaic, then prose not a list); L142 '이 유도에서 놓치기 쉬운 점이 있습니다.' (formulaic); L180 '이 상쇄가 미묘한 이유는' / L399 '이 해석이 미묘한 이유는' (repeated frame); L192 '이유가 여기에 있습니다' / L401 '근거가 여기에 있습니다' (repeated frame); L218 '존재하지 않을 수 있음도 보입니다' (noun frame; rewrite '존재하지 않을 수도 있다고 보입니다'); L528/L532 '...그래프입니다' identical figure intros; '할 수 있습니다' 13 and '즉' 12 occurrences outside math.
score_notes.C: Concepts introduced before use, '앞서' back-references accurate, toy example reused. Deductions: L441 and L443 say the same thing twice in adjacent paragraphs ('DPO에는 둘 다 필요 없습니다...' then '액터-크리틱 RLHF가 ... 처음부터 이 항이 없습니다'); L583 conclusion recap breaks the OOD/evaluator section flow.
score_notes.D: Hard parts get excellent help (L146 toy closed-form, L160 reward recovery check, L194 loss magnitude, L246-254 gradient-weight table, L369 projection check, L429 baseline-variance example). Over-explaining the trivial for a competent reader: L322 equivalence-relation axioms with a mod-3 example; L97 KL definition; L504 sampling-temperature definition; L463 LLM-as-judge definition; L565 inter-annotator agreement definition.
score_notes.E: Equations, code (L283-308, verbatim from paper), verbatim tables (L554-557, L567-575) placed where discussed, figures described not by paper numbering. Deductions: L528-534 two Best-of-N figures introduced only as '다음은 ... 그래프입니다' / '같은 비교를 ... 그래프입니다' with no reading of what they show (near-decorative).
score_notes.F: All checked numbers match the paper. Deductions: L563 '자원봉사자 25명입니다' omits that one late volunteer was excluded from analysis (paper App. D.3); L587 '데이터가 SFT 분포와 다른 정책에서 생성되었을 때 결과가 얼마나 유지되는지는 검증되지 않았습니다' overstates: TL;DR preferences were gathered on a different SFT model and HH responses come from an unknown LM (paper Sec. 6). Minor beyond-source elaborations attributed near the authors: L260 '손실에 하한이 없으므로 확률 질량이 질 낮은 임의의 시퀀스로 옮겨 갈 수 있다는 해석' (paper only says 'unconstrained likelihood minimization'); L150 and L218 characterise cited works (distribution matching, BTL MLE existence) with content not in the DPO paper (unverifiable here).
